time_basis: All stated clock times are UTC; metrics use recorded Pi host/MCAP receipt time.
findings: The operator reported a controlled first Sit/hold/left-paw/right-paw/stand chain without tipping or visible rotation. Repeats2/3 remained controlled but showed small (<10degree) counterclockwise rotation around sit-to-stand. These observations do not establish a repeatable physical pass.

Sensor drift was developing before chain1: increasingly negative episodes appear around20:02:35–20:03:05, while chain1 starts20:04:06.785. There is no uniquely identified sharp onset or demonstrated causal trick.

Between chains1/2, a camera-consistent quiet interval accumulates about60degrees of reported heading change. After chain3, another quiet interval accumulates about276degrees. The recurrence was not first created or first present after chain3.

Reported gyro remains elevated after Stop and walking-controller deactivation, through a camera-consistent interval after handling, and until full hardware shutdown. It does not return to the early supported baseline while the driver and motor boards remain active.

This supports a sensor/physical-scene discrepancy, not a diagnosis of thermal state, vibration, electrical interference or an individual policy. The later no-reset capture is separate evidence, with an unobserved78.623second gap after hardware shutdown.

session.unchanged: Native driver/controller libraries, model/reference inputs, gains and limits; offline static-idle optimization was not deployed.
session.source_provenance: Complete runtime manifest and32 frozen runtime inputs with exact paths/hashes are inside the original archive. Neural-controller hash is preserved in the prelaunch receipt; loaded hardware-interface bytes are frozen.

core_chain.actions: stand up, Sit entry, explicit10s hold, left paw, right paw, standing exit
core_chain.software_outcomes: All18 correlated jobs report succeeded; receipts prove software playback/completion, not physical stability.
core_chain.timing_interpretation: Sit entry retains5.5s minimum; requested clips play3.5s plus remaining old native1s idle-loop boundary wait; standing exit adds4.2s walking initialization/fade/readiness. These are not unexplained fixed paw sleeps.

camera_corroboration.method: Three manually selected fixed-background patches per quiet window; normalized correlation in a24px local search; hashes and every result preserved.
camera_corroboration.note: Camera-covered subsets have slightly different boundaries from the full-rate windows; no pixel-to-angle conversion or exactly-zero-motion claim.

stop_and_shutdown_tail.important_limit: Deactivating the controller retains estop_kd damping and does not disable boards or prove zero current. Final42.53s of native IMU have no saved camera coverage.

coverage.observers: Observer01 spans the supported/floor baseline for300s; observer02 spans repeats2/3 and later time for300s. Full MCAP covers the first-chain gap and continues past camera end.

limits: Host receipt time does not prove physical sensor sample freshness; related quaternion/gyro outputs are not independent ground truth.
Camera is raw fisheye imagery saved at approximately1Hz; fixed patch matches do not exclude subpixel or between-frame motion.
Each quiet camera window is independently anchored. Actual action movement, floor placement and later handling are not classified as stationary sensor error.
Operator observations are recorded reports, not external motion capture. Earlier partial observer figures remain preserved rather than replaced by a differently bounded full-record aggregate.
All18 software outcomes succeeded, but this session did not meet repeatable physical/sensor acceptance. No subsequent policy/gain/latency modification or motion was justified by these receipts.

artifacts.preservation: Unchanged original capture copied and hash-verified; every derived archive member reread/hash-verified. No tests rerun, robot contact or commit during preservation.
